title: Binary Adder Calculator
description: Add two binary numbers with every column addition and carry shown, plus a decimal check.
howto: Read each column’s sum and carry, then the final binary result.

faqs.a: 1+1 = 10₂: write 0, carry 1 — exactly like decimal, but the carry triggers at 2 instead of 10.
3 = 11₂: write 1, carry 1. The tool shows this in any column where both bits and the carry are 1.
Converting both inputs and the sum to decimal proves the binary addition is correct.
